# ReDimNet2 Upstream

The `redimnet2/` package and `LICENSE` in this directory are copied without
modification from the official MIT-licensed implementation:

- Repository: https://github.com/PalabraAI/redimnet2
- Commit: `cdc875670034dd7068013ca2ab21ec083a040ff8`
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11841

The experiment uses the official `b6-vox2-lm.pt` release asset from tag
`v1.0.0` and verifies SHA-256
`bc45f032099f3c9f0fb6ad756bca23daeeba456d00c515056e388824ef36f41b`
before evaluation.
